status: concept awaiting owner review; no model or runtime changes; animation compatibility not yet verified
owner_feedback: Variant 05 rejected: only the background matched the menu, not Pelag. Restyle the actual character while retaining original design, current saber, larger back anchor and existing animation constraints.
prompt:
Repaint and restyle THE CHARACTER HIMSELF from image 1 to belong to the visual language of image 2, the actual new game menu. This is a substantial CHARACTER ART-DIRECTION correction, not a background edit.

OUTPUT ON A COMPLETELY PLAIN LIGHT WARM-GREY STUDIO BACKGROUND. No clouds, smoke, rift, embers, fire, dramatic scenery or decorative border anywhere in the background. The style change MUST be clearly visible on Pelag's skin, face, hair, clothing and metal even with this neutral background.

KEEP the original Pelag identity, body and rig-compatible dimensions: head/body ratio, shoulder width, torso and limb lengths, hand size, knee/elbow positions, same short crossover shirt and split thigh-length hem, knee-length trousers, simple bracers, open low sandals. Keep the large anchor on his back and the exact current saber shape from image 3 (wide curved silver blade, stepped spine, gold crossguard, red central gem, teal ferrule, leather/red grip). Don't invent another costume, jacket, vest, long coat, armour or heroic bulk.

ACTUAL NEW CHARACTER STYLE:
- A grounded hand-painted dark-fantasy action-game protagonist, with strong sculpted planes, confident visible brushwork on forms, ink-wash shadow grouping, rich matte pigment and mineral highlights. Visually much closer to an oil-painted fantasy game hero than glossy children's-animation CGI. No soft shiny toy skin, plastic hair, airbrushed round cheeks, giant sparkling cartoon eyes.
- Same identifiable young adult Pelag face, but serious focused expression; angular cheek and brow shading, natural-sized less rounded eye treatment, restrained skin highlights, sun-weathered colour variations in broad strokes. Do not age into an old man, add a beard, scars or change facial identity.
- Hair: practical VERY SHORT DARK BROWN TEXTURED CROP, tight sides and nape, short coarse crown. Low compact silhouette, blunt rugged clumps, forehead mostly clear above the original narrow headband. No flowing forelock, anime spikes, floppy fringe, styled pompadour, ponytail or white streak.
- Recolour the ACTUAL GARMENTS into the MENU'S MATERIAL PALETTE: warm bone/ivory cloth main masses; smoked desaturated PETROL BLUE edging replacing the old bright turquoise; weathered COPPER/EMBER-RUST sash, headband and V-neck accent replacing bubblegum pink. Keep the placement and large diamond motif of original Pelag. Cloth's actual deep fold planes are painted blue-grey, lit broad planes warm bone-white. The player should immediately see this palette on the character without the menu background.
- Chest and legs remain predominately LIGHT, NOT an all-black outfit. Deep smoky accents only as measured colour blocks and painted shadow planes. Leather is matte umber with sparse broad wear, not shiny plastic. Bracers are simple solid forms.
- Large anchor: dense aged blue-grey steel, thick broad flukes, a few crisp silver worn edges, forged surface painted as broad mineral planes; no excessive scratches, no glowing weapon, no angular low-poly replacement. About 0.95m high and 0.6m wide, functional diagonal back carry clear of knees, heavy chain of coherent interlocking links. Retain exact saber design, render the metal and old-gold fittings in the same painterly material language.
- Bigger, cleaner strokes and fold shapes, fewer small details; no stitches, patchwork, decorative trinkets, all-over grunge, many extra straps or particle effects.

Composition: landscape single-character design study. Large full-body front three-quarter Pelag at left, current saber fully visible low in right hand. Upper right head-and-shoulders portrait that clearly shows the new haircut and painterly face; lower right full-body rear view showing anchor and garment shapes. All views identical design and materials. Full feet visible, natural confident stance. Plain warm-grey background and simple contact shadows only. No text. Final check: if you cover the background, the character must still look radically less glossy/cartoon-cute and more painterly, smoky, mineral and rugged, while still unmistakably being our original Pelag in his original outfit.
